notes.title: Hotfix #2 is Live! Join our Dev Live Chat on Friday!
notes.notes:
Hello mechanics!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059776/8a5018d0e0564eaff5cf4b074a0b9ae4a045226b.png
We’ve been receiving plenty of feedback from you guys. It’s absolutely great for two reasons:
[olist]
 we get to fix the game,
 it means you care!
[/olist]
So yeah, even though it’s just the prologue, we’re following up the first hotfix with another one. There are fewer fixes now, but they were more difficult to figure out than the earlier ones, so we’re kinda proud of ourselves!

Changelog

 Fixed an issue with wrong subtitles appearing when changing the language during the service.
 Fixed the faulty visualization of braking while driving (your car won’t be randomly showing braking lights while driving).
 Font correction with missing characters for the Chinese language.
 Fixed blocking of the camera after a quick exit from the car after disassembling parts.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059776/24a3c5890b196497341617876a47fe10af7c7dad.gif

Join our Live Stream on Discord!
We also have some fun news for you. Aleks from the development team will host a live chat on our Discord server this Friday (26th of July) at 6 PM CEST. He’ll be showcasing some of the things he’s been working on and you will have a possibility to talk to him and to give him suggestions on how to modify the driving model of the game!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059776/5dac3f47398dd1de8599ef1250ff2609b003b053.gif
Join us HERE on Friday!

notes.title: Hotfix #1 is here!
notes.notes:
Hey there, Mechanics!

We've just rolled out our first patch, fixing a bunch of bugs. Huge thanks for the awesome reception - we know bugs happen, so your feedback means the world to us!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059776/0c3fc02f2d38f022825ae6d61581e72dd05057e6.png

Patch notes


 Fixed typos in localization.
 Fixed UI elements that weren't localized properly.
 UI changes (so it would be clearer in some languages).
 Fixed an issue that made playing the game impossible when using an alphabet other than en-US.
 Changed behavior of outlines when in service mode or working with screws.
 Fixed saving and loading of some settings.
 Fixed UI that was positioned wrong during the rally.
 Improved some animations.
 Fixed relations between parts in the boxer engine.
 Turned off interactions with floor and engine covers.
 Fixed a screw positioning issue that occurred when canceling assembly/disassembly.
 Fixed an issue with part names not showing up when a player goes to a rally again.
 Fixed an issue with the wrong UI key hints display.

We're always eager to hear from you, so drop by our Discord server.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059776/5dac3f47398dd1de8599ef1250ff2609b003b053.gif

High-five and stay tuned because we don't stop here!
